title: Pokemon TCG Staryu Perfect Order 020/088 Common Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Staryu-020/088 - Reverse Holo Pokémon card from the Perfect Order set, manufactured by Nintendo in 2026, features the character Staryu in English language. This basic stage Pokemon card is part of the Pokémon TCG game and is illustrated by Takeshi Nakamura. The card is a common rarity, made of card stock, and suitable for ages 6 and above. With its unique reverse holo design, this collectible card is a must-have for any Pokémon card collector looking to add a perfect piece to their collection.
